cases.name: Lisa Lorraine Bunce
cases.about: Neighbor Neal Puffer says he'll remember Bunce for her loving personality. "She was the sweetest, funniest person I've ever known," he said. "She’s always happy."
cases.narrative: She was found in a closet. Shot in head. He forced entry into the home while armed with a 9mm Glock handgun.
